description: Average Passenger Boardings By Route 2015-16 - Weekdays is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. The Average Passenger Boardings By Route 2015-16 for weekdays on the ACTION network. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are ticketing, passenger boardings, routes, patronage, boardings. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transport Canberra. The portal shows 2017-12-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
